name: stayflow
description: StayFlow hotel management and booking system

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,website,dashboard "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace apps/website" "npm run dev --workspace apps/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace apps/website && npm run build --workspace apps/dashboard
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace apps/website && npm run lint --workspace apps/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/website && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/dashboard
